text: タマムシ　シティの　デパート　いろいろ　うってて　べんりよね

structure.jp: タマムシ　シティの　デパート
structure.en: the department store in Celadon City

structure.jp: いろいろ　うってて
structure.en: sells all sorts of things and

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows how things regularly are; うってて is the shortened form of うっていて. うってて = 'it sells them, and'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The final て joins this part to the next, like 'and' or 'so'. うってて　べんり = 'it sells things and so is handy'.

patterns.name: 〜よね
patterns.explanation: よね at the end says something you believe and asks the listener to agree; with no だ before it, it sounds feminine. べんりよね = 'it's handy, isn't it?'.
